skill.name: verification-quality-assurance
skill.description: Quality assurance workflow for scoring AI and code outputs, running verification checks, exporting reports, and coordinating rollback gates.
skill.summary: Verify code quality, monitor truth scores, and manage rollback workflows with Claude Flow.
skill.author: DNYoussef

security_audit.summary: No prompt injection attempt was found in SKILL.md. The file is mostly documentation, and many static hits are Markdown formatting false positives, but it still instructs users to run unpinned npx commands, install shell hooks, export metrics to external endpoints, use a secret in a URL query string, and run destructive rollback commands.

remediation.suggestion: Pin claude-flow to a reviewed version and require explicit confirmation before any npx command runs.
Replace hard reset examples with dry-run, backup-first, and manual approval workflows.
Make network export opt-in, document payload contents, and require users to configure trusted endpoints.

remediation.issue: Secret passed in URL query string
remediation.suggestion: Pass API keys through headers or the monitoring client configuration, not query parameters.
Use mktemp or another unique temporary path and remove the file after verification completes.

content.user_title: Verify Code Quality With Truth Scores
content.value_statement: AI-assisted code changes can be hard to trust before merge. This skill helps teams score outputs, run verification checks, and connect quality gates to CI, rollback, and monitoring workflows.
actual_capabilities: Shows truth scores for code, agents, and tasks on a zero to one scale.
Runs verification checks for files, directories, tasks, and batch workflows.
Describes rollback commands for failed verification states and selective recovery.
Exports verification reports in table, JSON, CSV, HTML, and markdown formats.
Documents CI quality gates, pre-commit hooks, dashboards, and metric export workflows.
limitations: Requires Claude Flow and Node.js to run the documented commands.
Rollback workflows depend on a clean and reliable Git history.
Truth scores are quality indicators, not formal proof of correctness.
External monitoring exports require careful endpoint and secret configuration.

use_cases.title: Review Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Run verification before merge and summarize weak areas that need fixes.

use_cases.title: Gate CI Pipelines
use_cases.description: Add score thresholds and report artifacts to automated build checks.

use_cases.title: Monitor Agent Quality
use_cases.description: Track agent output trends and identify tasks with declining reliability.

prompt_templates.title: Check Current Scores
prompt_templates.prompt: Show current truth scores for this project and summarize any items below 0.85.

prompt_templates.title: Verify Changed Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Run verification for the files changed in this branch. Explain failed checks and suggest fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Create CI Gate
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a CI quality gate with a 0.95 threshold. Include report export, artifact handling, and failure messaging.

prompt_templates.title: Design Release Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a rollback-safe verification workflow for a multi-agent feature release. Include thresholds, monitoring, and manual approval points.

output_examples.input: Review a pull request before merge.
output_examples.output: Verification finds two weak areas: missing input validation and low test coverage. It recommends fixes before merging.

output_examples.input: Monitor an agent workflow for one day.
output: Trend reporting shows improvement after added tests.

output_examples.input: Prepare a quality gate for release.
output_examples.output: The workflow uses a 0.95 threshold, stores a report artifact, and requires manual approval before rollback.

best_practices: Run verification before merge and again after major automated edits.
Use stricter thresholds for production code than for experiments.
Review rollback actions manually before allowing destructive changes.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a high score as a replacement for human review.
Do not run rollback commands when uncommitted work is not backed up.
Do not send metrics to external endpoints without approval.

faq.question: What does this skill verify?
faq.answer: It describes checks for correctness, security, performance, documentation, and coding practices.

faq.question: Does it prove code is correct?
faq.answer: No. It provides quality signals and workflow gates that still need review.

faq.question: Can it run in CI?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes examples for CI quality gates and report artifacts.

faq.question: Can it roll back changes?
faq.answer: It documents rollback workflows, but destructive rollback should require explicit approval.

faq.question: Does it send data outside the project?
faq.answer: Only if users enable the documented monitoring export examples.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
